_comment: Golden replay/state-hash oracle for the pane perf gate (bd-1pvzq.3). Pins the deterministic baseline_hash and final_hash the pane_profile_harness produces for each scenario; a drift means the optimized pane execution no longer reproduces the certified state (a behavior regression, not a timing one). aggregate_hash is intentionally NOT pinned (it XOR-mixes over iterations and so depends on --iterations). Regenerate after an intended behavior change with: scripts/pane_replay_artifacts.py certify --index <bundle>/replay_artifact_index.json --golden scripts/pane_replay_golden.json --update-golden
